md:HB 548.summary: Requires local governments to judge housing development applications under the laws in effect when a complete application is submitted, decide completeness within 30 days, and gives approved projects vested development rights for the longer of five years or a locally set period.

md:HB 552.title: Commission on the House of Reformation and Instruction for Colored Children - Establishment
md:HB 552.summary: Creates the Commission on the House of Reformation and Instruction for Colored Children to direct an investigation of the historic site, including locating graves, identifying people buried there, notifying descendants, and a final report by December 31, 2029.

md:HB 561.title: Maryland Child Care Credential Program - Extension of Funding
md:HB 561.summary: Requires the Governor to appropriate $5,687,000 to the Maryland Child Care Credential Program in each of fiscal years 2028 through 2030.

md:HB 571.title: Nonprofit Housing Corporations - Taxes and Special Assessments Exemptions - Alterations
md:HB 571.summary: Broadens the definition of nonprofit housing corporation for property tax and special assessment exemptions and extends the exemption to certain subsidiaries, except for property in Baltimore City.

md:HB 573.title: Fair Housing and Housing Discrimination - Regulations, Intent, and Discriminatory Effect
md:HB 573.summary: Bars housing practices that have a discriminatory effect, meaning a disparate impact on protected groups or reinforcing segregated housing patterns, even without intent. Authorizes the housing department to adopt regulations on affirmatively furthering fair housing.

md:HB 586.title: County Boards of Library Trustees - Membership - Student Member
md:HB 586.summary: Lets a county library board of trustees choose a student member, and sets qualifications, a one-year term and voting rights for that member.

md:HB 6.title: Public Institutions of Higher Education - Pregnant and Parenting Students - Plan and Reporting
md:HB 6.summary: Requires the Higher Education Commission to collect data on students' parental status from public colleges and universities, requires community colleges to adopt a plan for pregnant and parenting students, and requires a report to the legislature by September 1, 2027.

md:HB 680.title: Children's Cabinet Fund - Renaming and Funding for Grants to Local Management Boards
md:HB 680.summary: Renames the Children's Cabinet Fund the Children's Cabinet Interagency Fund and requires budget appropriations to it for fiscal years 2028-2030 at least equal to 2027's, then $500,000 more in 2031, for grants to local management boards.

md:HB 684.title: Health Insurance - Material Changes to Provider Networks - Notification and Special Enrollment Period
md:HB 684.summary: Changes notice requirements for health insurers and health systems about contract terminations and provider network changes, requiring notice to enrollees and the Insurance Commissioner.

md:HB 711.title: Data Privacy - Consumer Data, Public Records, and Message Switching System (Data Privacy Act)
md:HB 711.summary: Bars data controllers from knowingly selling consumers' personal data to government units that have engaged in or supported civil immigration enforcement, and requires public record custodians and message switching system operators to take steps related to immigration-enforcement access.

md:HB 742.title: Growing Family Child Care Opportunities Program - Funding
md:HB 742.summary: Requires the Governor to include $450,000 in the annual budget for the Growing Family Child Care Opportunities Program in fiscal years 2028 through 2030.

md:HB 805.title: Building Homes Act
md:HB 805.summary: Lets Baltimore City and counties or municipalities grant a property tax credit on homes with nonprofit-provided mortgages and covenants that keep the price affordable, for tax years after June 30, 2026.

md:HB 811.title: Aging-in-Place Programs - Grants - Multigenerational Third Places ( Village Multigenerational Third Places Act)
md:HB 811.summary: Lets the Department of Aging give grants to nonprofits and area agencies on aging to support social connection for aging-in-place participants through events at multigenerational third places, meaning community spaces used by people of different ages.

md:HB 816.title: Maryland Automobile Insurance Fund - Affordability Program and Industry Automobile Insurance Association Assessments
md:HB 816.summary: Changes the cap on an insurer assessment allocation percentage for the Industry Automobile Insurance Association and lets the Maryland Automobile Insurance Fund's director set up an affordability program.

md:HB 849.title: Child Care Scholarship Program - Freeze in Enrollment - Exceptions and Waitlist
md:HB 849.summary: Bars Child Care Scholarship enrollment freezes from covering certain groups such as children with enrolled siblings and homeless children, and requires a waitlist with priority enrollment for certain applicants.

md:HB 862.title: Railroads - Required Crew for Movement of Freight
md:HB 862.summary: Bars freight trains from operating in Maryland with fewer than two crew members, with exceptions, and sets fines of up to $10,000, or up to $25,000 for a willful violation within 3 years of a prior one.

md:HB 866.title: Workgroup for the Deaf, Deafblind, and Hard of Hearing - Extension
md:HB 866.summary: Extends the Workgroup for the Deaf, Deafblind, and Hard of Hearing to December 31, 2028, and moves its report deadline to December 1, 2028.

md:HB 894.title: Land Use - Transit-Oriented Development - Alterations (Maryland Transit and Housing Opportunity Act)
md:HB 894.summary: Makes new transit-oriented developments near frequent rail service enterprise zones unless the local government opts out, prioritizes land near rail stations for state infrastructure loans, and bars local minimum parking requirements and some land use limits near stations.

md:HB 919.title: Maryland Higher Education Commission - Practical Applications of Real Estate Appraisal (PAREA) Grant Program - Established
md:HB 919.summary: Creates a grant program, run by the Maryland Higher Education Commission, to help people become real estate appraisers in historically redlined and underrepresented communities.

md:SB 16.title: Child Support - Earnings Withholdings Limits
md:SB 16.summary: Caps child support earnings withholding at 35% of disposable earnings for obligors whose income is at or below 250% of the federal poverty level for one person, and lets employees contest withholding amounts.

md:SB 168.title: Study to Evaluate Blockchain-Based Real Property Lease and Title Recordation and Verification
md:SB 168.summary: Requires the State Department of Assessments and Taxation to study using blockchain to record and verify property ownership and leases, including for squatting disputes, and report by December 31, 2026.

md:SB 169.title: Hospitals - Emergency Pregnancy-Related Medical Conditions - Procedures
md:SB 169.summary: Requires hospitals to screen emergency department patients for emergency pregnancy-related conditions, sets rules for their treatment and transfer, and requires hospitals to allow pregnancy termination in certain circumstances.

md:SB 198.title: Prince George's Community College - Aerospace and Aviation Systems Technology Programs - Feasibility Study
md:SB 198.summary: Requires Prince George's Community College to study aerospace and aviation systems technology training programs and report to the General Assembly by December 1, 2027, with $100,000 in the 2028 budget for the study.

md:SB 244.title: Code Revision - Health - Maryland Medical Assistance Program
md:SB 244.summary: Revises, restates and recodifies the State's laws on the Maryland Medical Assistance Program.

md:SB 252.title: Maryland Legal Services Corporation - Board of Directors - Membership
md:SB 252.summary: Increases the Maryland Legal Services Corporation Board of Directors from 9 to 12 members.

md:SB 253.title: Baltimore County Public Library - Collective Bargaining - Supervisory Employees
md:SB 253.summary: Lets supervisory employees of the Baltimore County Public Library form or join employee organizations and bargain collectively, and authorizes bargaining units for library employees.

md:SB 276.title: Maryland Medical Assistance Program and Health Insurance - Coverage for Orthoses and Prostheses (So Every Body Can Move Act)
md:SB 276.summary: Requires Medicaid and certain insurers to cover orthoses starting January 1, 2027, and clarifies that required prosthesis coverage includes all prostheses a provider finds medically necessary for daily living, work or physical activities.

md:SB 30.title: Baltimore County - Property Tax Credit - Fraternal Order of Police Lodge 34
md:SB 30.summary: Lets Baltimore County grant a 100% county property tax credit on certain real property owned by Fraternal Order of Police Lodge 34, for tax years after June 30, 2026.

md:SB 322.title: Courts - Jury Service - Disqualification
md:SB 322.summary: Changes jury disqualification: a person convicted of a crime punishable by over a year is disqualified while serving the sentence, including parole or probation. Also disqualifies those convicted of perjury, witness or jury intimidation, or fraud crimes. Repeals the pardon provision.

md:SB 324.title: Higher Education - Public Senior Higher Education Institutions - Direct Admission Program and Study
md:SB 324.summary: Creates a direct admission program at participating public senior colleges starting 2028-2029, offering conditional admission with a waived application fee to high school students who meet set requirements, including college and career ready standards and a minimum GPA.

md:SB 325.title: Land Use - Permitting - Development Rights (Maryland Housing Certainty Act)
md:SB 325.summary: Requires housing development applications to be judged only under laws in effect when a complete application is submitted, and gives approved projects vested development rights for 5 years or a locally set period, whichever is longer.

md:SB 366.title: Motor Vehicles - Intelligent Speed Assistance System Pilot Program - Establishment
md:SB 366.summary: Creates a pilot program requiring people facing certain driver's license suspensions or revocations to get a restricted license and use an aftermarket intelligent speed assistance device that prevents the vehicle from exceeding the speed limit.

md:SB 379.title: Recovery Residence Grant Program - Funding
md:SB 379.summary: Extends through fiscal year 2030 the requirement to include $500,000 in the state budget for the Recovery Residence Grant Program.

md:SB 401.title: Anne Arundel County - Board of License Commissioners and Part-Time Inspectors - Compensation
md:SB 401.summary: Raises annual salaries for the chair, part-time inspectors and other members of the Anne Arundel County Board of License Commissioners and includes cost-of-living increases given to nonrepresented county employees.

md:SB 410.title: Public Libraries - State Library Resource Center - Funding
md:SB 410.summary: Changes how State Library Resource Center funding is calculated, starting in fiscal year 2028.

md:SB 414.title: Anne Arundel County - Alcoholic Beverages - Consumption-Only Nonprofit Swim Club License
md:SB 414.summary: Creates a $100 annual consumption-only license for nonprofit swim clubs in Anne Arundel County, letting members and guests bring their own alcohol to designated events, up to five days a year between 2 p.m. and 10 p.m.

md:SB 450.title: Carroll County - Office of Permits and Inspections - Denial of Commercial Permit or License for Unpaid Personal Property Taxes
md:SB 450.summary: Lets the Carroll County Office of Permits and Inspections deny or refuse to renew a commercial license or permit for unpaid personal property taxes, unless the applicant disputes the amount, and allows issuance once the taxes are shown to be paid.

md:SB 459.title: Procurement - Advertising - Maryland News Organizations (Local News for Maryland Communities Act of 2026)
md:SB 459.summary: Requires state agencies to direct at least 50% of their advertising contract dollars to Maryland news organizations, prioritizing those serving underserved communities, and allows consulting a nonprofit to keep a list of eligible local news organizations.

md:SB 461.title: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program - Heat and Eat Program - Study
md:SB 461.summary: Requires the Department of Human Services to study how many households lose automatic utility allowance eligibility in the SNAP Heat and Eat program under the 2025 federal budget law, and report findings and recommendations by December 1, 2026.

md:SB 467.title: Maryland Child Care Credential Program - Extension of Funding
md:SB 467.summary: Requires the Governor to include $5,687,000 a year in the budget for the Maryland Child Care Credential Program in fiscal years 2028 through 2030.

md:SB 469.title: Maryland Automobile Insurance Fund - Affordability Program and Industry Automobile Insurance Association Assessments
md:SB 469.summary: Lowers from 3% to 1% the cap on an insurer assessment allocation percentage for the Industry Automobile Insurance Association, and lets the Maryland Automobile Insurance Fund's director set up an affordability program.

md:SB 496.title: Maryland Medical Assistance Program - Coverage for the Treatment of Obesity - Authorization
md:SB 496.summary: Allows the Maryland Medical Assistance Program to cover treatment of obesity starting January 1, 2027, and lets the Health Department seek federal approval for that coverage.

md:SB 497.title: Property Tax - City of Hagerstown and the Hagerstown Multi-Use Sports and Events Facility, Inc. - Exemption
md:SB 497.summary: Exempts property owned by the City of Hagerstown and used for public social, recreational and entertainment purposes from property tax, retroactive to fiscal year 2024, with refunds of excess tax paid.

md:SB 521.title: Health Insurance - Material Changes to Provider Networks - Notification and Special Enrollment Period
md:SB 521.summary: Changes notice requirements for health insurers and health systems about contract terminations and provider network changes, requiring notice to enrollees and the Insurance Commissioner.

md:SB 530.title: Aging-in-Place Programs - Grants - Multigenerational Third Places (Village Multigenerational Third Places Act)
md:SB 530.summary: Lets the Department of Aging give grants to nonprofits and area agencies on aging for events at multigenerational third places that support social connection among people in aging-in-place programs.

md:SB 532.title: Higher Education Institutions - Over-the-Counter Contraception - Access and Reporting
md:SB 532.summary: Requires public colleges and community colleges to report annually on contraception access, and requires community colleges to give students access to all over-the-counter contraception methods.

md:SB 535.title: County Boards of Library Trustees - Membership - Student Member
md:SB 535.summary: Lets a county library board of trustees choose a student member, and sets qualifications, a one-year term and voting rights for that member.

md:SB 58.title: Property Tax Credit - Retail Service Station Conversions
md:SB 58.summary: Lets Baltimore City and counties or municipalities grant a property tax credit on land converted from a retail gas station to other uses, only if underground storage tanks have been permanently closed.

md:SB 597.title: Higher Education - Maryland Artificial Intelligence Partnership
md:SB 597.summary: Creates the Maryland Artificial Intelligence Partnership within the University System of Maryland to coordinate AI workforce, business and research efforts, with a strategic plan due December 1, 2026. Also creates an AI public services fellowship and, conditionally, an AI incubation lab.

md:SB 6.title: State Personnel - Collective Bargaining - Nontenure Track Faculty
md:SB 6.summary: Gives collective bargaining rights to nontenure-track faculty at University System of Maryland institutions, Morgan State University and St. Mary's College, and creates a separate bargaining unit for them.

md:SB 637.title: Maryland Automobile Insurance Fund - Fund Producer Commission Rate
md:SB 637.summary: Lowers the minimum commission the Maryland Automobile Insurance Fund pays producers on private passenger auto policies from 10% to 5% of premium, and bars commissions on policies the Fund writes directly.

md:SB 657.title: Maryland Higher Education Commission - Practical Applications of Real Estate Appraisal (PAREA) Grant Program - Established
md:SB 657.summary: Creates a Higher Education Commission grant program for minority residents of historically redlined and underrepresented communities to complete Practical Applications of Real Estate Appraisal (PAREA) training, aimed at closing appraisal gaps and diversifying the appraisal field.

md:SB 668.title: Children's Cabinet Fund - Renaming and Funding for Grants to Local Management Boards
md:SB 668.summary: Renames the Children's Cabinet Fund the Children's Cabinet Interagency Fund and requires budget appropriations to it for fiscal years 2028-2030 at least equal to 2027's, then $500,000 more in 2031, for grants to local management boards.

md:SB 729.title: Real Property - Access to Counsel in Evictions Program - Expansion
md:SB 729.summary: Extends the Access to Counsel in Evictions Program to residents of mobile home parks, giving them legal representation in repossession actions and requiring outreach, an informational pamphlet and annual reporting that cover them.

md:SB 739.title: Climate Change, Homeowner's Insurance, and Emergency Management - Study
md:SB 739.summary: Requires the University System of Maryland to study how climate change affects homeowner's insurance availability and cost and emergency preparedness, and report recommendations to the General Assembly by July 1, 2027, including on flood insurance programs.

md:SB 747.title: Condominiums - Unit Owner Responsibility for Damage or Destruction and Mandatory Insurance Coverage
md:SB 747.summary: Makes certain condominium unit owners responsible for repair or replacement costs for damage under set conditions, requires councils of unit owners to notify owners annually, and requires unit owners to carry a unit owner insurance policy.

md:SB 769.title: University System of Maryland - Academic Facilities Bonding Authority
md:SB 769.summary: Approves academic facilities projects for the University System of Maryland and authorizes it to issue bonds to finance them, which are not debts of the State.

md:SB 791.title: Correctional Services and Criminal Procedure - Immigration Enforcement - Prohibitions (Community Trust Act)
md:SB 791.summary: Bars local jails from holding people over immigration status or federal requests without a judicial warrant, asking about status, or notifying federal authorities of custody, with exceptions. Limits police sharing information with immigration authorities without a court order.

md:SB 852.title: Anne Arundel County – Alcoholic Beverages – Barbershop and Beauty Salon License
md:SB 852.summary: Lets Anne Arundel County barbershop and beauty salon license holders serve each customer up to 1.7 ounces of liquor per visit for on-premises consumption, in addition to beer and wine.

md:SB 864.title: Higher Education - Tuition Exemption for Foster Care Recipients - Eligibility
md:SB 864.summary: Lowers from 13 to 8 the age on or after which a person must have lived in an out-of-home placement to qualify for the foster care tuition and mandatory fee exemption at public colleges. Takes effect July 1, 2026.

md:SB 865.title: Workgroup on the Affordability of Private Passenger Automobile Insurance – Extension and Alteration of Membership and Duties
md:SB 865.summary: Extends the auto insurance affordability workgroup to June 30, 2027, changes its membership, and adds duties to develop specific recommendations to reduce premiums, including on territorial rating. Requires an updated report by January 1, 2027.

md:SB 941.title: Safe and Healthy Homes for All Act
md:SB 941.summary: Requires the housing department's landlord and tenant office to develop a plan, due August 31, 2027, to identify rental properties with 50 or more units that pose severe health and safety risks and propose interventions, and to publish a list of those properties online.

mi:HB 4011.title: Property: conveyance of state property; transfer of certain state-owned property in Arenac County; provide for. Creates land transfer act.
mi:HB 4011.summary: As introduced, authorizes the State Administrative Board to convey about 118 acres of state land in Arenac County, site of the closed Standish Maximum Correctional Facility, by competitive sale, sale to local government, or transfer.

mi:HB 4135.title: Property: conveyance of state property; conveyance of certain state-owned property in Jackson County; provide for. Creates land transfer act.
mi:HB 4135.summary: As introduced, authorizes the State Administrative Board to convey about 81 acres of state land in Jackson County, with Jackson County given first right to buy it for $1.00 within two years of enactment.

mi:HB 4598.title: Crimes: organized; violations of the organized retail crime act; expand. Amends sec. 4 of 2012 PA 455 (MCL 752.1084).
mi:HB 4598.summary: As introduced, makes it organized retail crime, a felony punishable by up to 5 years, to knowingly and with intent to defraud acquire, alter, or exploit gift cards or gift card redemption information.

mi:HB 4599.title: Crimes: organized; gift card fraud; provide for. Amends 2012 PA 455 (MCL 752.1081 - 752.1087) by adding sec. 3a.   TIE BAR WITH: HB 4598'25
mi:HB 4599.summary: As introduced, defines gift card, gift card redemption information, and closed- and open-loop gift cards for use in HB 4598's gift card fraud offenses; takes effect only if both bills are enacted.

mi:HB 4678.title: Agriculture: weights and measures; certain definitions; provide for. Amends 1964 PA 283 (MCL 290.601 - 290.635) by adding sec. 28g.   TIE BAR WITH: HB 4679'25
mi:HB 4678.summary: As introduced, lets qualified equipment rental businesses sell motor fuel to refill rented equipment at a flat rate or per-gallon fee, if stated in the rental contract.

mi:HB 4679.title: Agriculture: weights and measures; certain definitions; provide for. Amends secs. 10 & 28c of 1964 PA 283 (MCL 290.610 & 290.628c).   TIE BAR WITH: HB 4678'25
mi:HB 4679.summary: As introduced, says the Department of Agriculture and Rural Development need not inspect and test each qualified fuel dispenser, and treats testing requirements as met if the dispenser complies with HB 4678 and federal transportation rules.

mi:HB 4703.title: Insurance: health insurers; coverage for group prenatal care services; require. Amends 1956 PA 218 (MCL 500.100 - 500.8302) by adding sec. 3406ss.
mi:HB 4703.summary: As introduced, requires health insurance policies issued or renewed in Michigan on or after January 1, 2026 to cover group prenatal care services.

mi:HB 5120.title: Civil procedure: service of process; cost for service of process for personal protection orders; eliminate. Amends secs. 2559 & 2950 of 1961 PA 236 (MCL 600.2559 & 600.2950).   TIE BAR WITH: HB 5121'25,  HB 6033'26
mi:HB 5120.summary: Under proposed substitute H-1, bars courts and police from charging personal protection order petitioners service fees, and sets requirements for the contents and service of domestic relationship protection orders.

mi:HB 5121.title: Civil procedure: service of process; cost for service of process for personal protection orders; eliminate. Amends sec. 2950a of 1961 PA 236 (MCL 600.2950a) & adds secs. 2950d & 2950p.   TIE BAR WITH: HB 5120'25,  HB 6033'26
mi:HB 5121.summary: Under proposed substitute H-1, bars courts and police from charging personal protection order petitioners service fees, creates a fund from which police may collect a $50 service fee, and sets rules for serving orders.

mi:HB 5356.title: Vehicles: title; requirements for transfer of title by a dealer; provide for. Amends 14, 41a, 78, 217, 217c, 233, 233a, 233b, 234, 238, 239, 240, 248, 248a, 248j, 249, 250, 258, 801b, 806 & 810a of 1949 PA 300 (MCL 257.14 et seq.) & adds sec. 9b.
mi:HB 5356.summary: As introduced, makes several Vehicle Code changes, including raising the maximum police salvage inspection fee from $100 to $125 and raising title bond value thresholds to $5,000 for licensed new vehicle dealers.

mi:HB 5482.title: State agencies (existing): generally; plans to correct audit recommendations; require notification to the legislature if the executive branch fails to prepare. Amends sec. 242 of 1984 PA 431 (MCL 18.1242).
mi:HB 5482.summary: Removes the requirement that appropriation acts for capital outlay projects include State Building Authority rental payments for the authorized projects.

mi:HB 5485.summary: As introduced, revises Michigan's dam safety rules, including new definitions, changing the impounding-capacity threshold for covered dams to 15 acre-feet, and amending hazard-potential classifications and emergency action plan requirements.

mi:HB 5514.title: Children: other; prohibition of use of certain restraints while transporting youths to certain qualified residential treatment programs; provide for. Creates new act.
mi:HB 5514.summary: As introduced, bars youth transportation companies from using blindfolds, hoods, handcuffs, chains or other mechanical or physical restraints on youths being taken to qualified residential treatment programs, with exceptions.

mi:HB 6033.title: Civil procedure: costs and fees; fees for service of process; revise. Amends sec. 2559 of 1961 PA 236 (MCL 600.2559).
mi:HB 6033.summary: As introduced, bars courts and police from charging personal protection order petitioners service fees and raises existing service-of-process fees in other cases.

mi:HB 6127.title: Gaming: other; expenditures in the internet gaming fund; modify. Amends secs. 14 & 16 of 2019 PA 152 (MCL 432.314 & 432.316).
mi:HB 6127.summary: Raises the annual Internet Gaming Fund allocation to the first responder presumed coverage fund from $2.0 million to up to $7.0 million (half its claim and administrative costs), and allocates $1.0 million a year for tribal governments.

mi:HB 6259.title: Criminal procedure: sentencing guidelines; sentencing guidelines for criminal sexual conduct; modify. Amends sec. 16y, ch. XVII of 1927 PA 175 (MCL 777.16y).   TIE BAR WITH: HB 6261'26,  HB 6262'26
mi:HB 6259.summary: As introduced, reclassifies second- and third-degree criminal sexual conduct in the sentencing guidelines as Class A felonies with a statutory maximum of life; takes effect only if HB 6261 and 6262 are enacted.

mi:HB 6260.title: Crimes: criminal sexual conduct; penalties for criminal sexual conduct in the first degree; modify. Amends sec. 520b of 1931 PA 328 (MCL 750.520b).
mi:HB 6260.summary: As introduced, sets a 15-year mandatory minimum sentence for first-degree criminal sexual conduct, which already carries a maximum of life.

mi:HB 6261.title: Crimes: criminal sexual conduct; penalties for criminal sexual conduct in the second degree; modify. Amends sec. 520c of 1931 PA 328 (MCL 750.520c).
mi:HB 6261.summary: As introduced, sets a 10-year mandatory minimum and raises the maximum from 15 years to life for second-degree criminal sexual conduct.

mi:HB 6262.title: Crimes: criminal sexual conduct; penalties for criminal sexual conduct in the third degree; modify. Amends sec. 520d of 1931 PA 328 (MCL 750.520d).
mi:HB 6262.summary: As introduced, sets a 5-year mandatory minimum and raises the maximum from 15 years to life for third-degree criminal sexual conduct.

mi:HB 6263.title: Crimes: criminal sexual conduct; penalties for criminal sexual conduct in the fourth degree; modify. Amends sec. 520e of 1931 PA 328 (MCL 750.520e).
mi:HB 6263.summary: As introduced, changes fourth-degree criminal sexual conduct from a misdemeanor to a felony, keeping the 2-year maximum prison term.

mi:HB 6282.title: Public employees and officers: ethics; moratorium on former legislators accepting employment with an entity that receives a grant from the utility consumer participation board; provide for. Creates new act.
mi:HB 6282.summary: As introduced, bars former state legislators for two years after leaving office from working for an entity receiving a Utility Consumer Participation Board grant; violations are misdemeanors with up to 90 days in jail or a $1,000 fine.

mi:HB 6302.title: Education: school districts; requirement to display an American flag in classrooms; provide for. Amends sec. 1347 of 1976 PA 451 (MCL 380.1347).
mi:HB 6302.summary: As introduced, requires school boards to ensure a U.S. flag is displayed, hoisted, draped, or placed on a stand in a prominent location in each classroom where students recite the Pledge of Allegiance.

mi:HB 6309.title: Highways: memorial; portion of M-86; designate as the "Casey Rice Memorial Highway". Amends 2001 PA 142 (MCL 250.1001 - 250.2092) by adding sec. 116.
mi:HB 6309.summary: As introduced, designates M-86 in Branch County between US-12 and Arbogast Road as the "Casey Rice Memorial Highway."

mi:HR 373.title: A resolution to condemn socialism, the platform of the Democratic Socialists for America, and politicians who espouse socialist views, and to oppose the implementation of socialist policies in the state of Michigan and the United States.
mi:HR 373.summary: Condemns socialism, the platform of the Democratic Socialists for America, and politicians who espouse socialist views, and opposes socialist policies in Michigan and the United States.

mi:SB 198.title: Occupations: vehicles, dealers, and repair facilities; requirements for automobile dealer data collection; provide for. Creates new act.
mi:SB 198.summary: As introduced, bars vehicle manufacturers and third parties from accessing, sharing or using protected dealer data, including consumer and diagnostic data, without the dealer's written consent, and from limiting dealers' use of it.

mi:SB 217.title: Traffic control: accidents; penalties for moving violation causing physical injury or death to a vulnerable roadway user; enhance. Amends sec. 12e, ch. XVII of 1927 PA 175 (MCL 777.12e).   TIE BAR WITH: SB 0216'25
mi:SB 217.summary: As introduced, adds the new felonies for moving violations that seriously injure or kill vulnerable roadway users, such as pedestrians, to the sentencing guidelines; tied to SB 216.

mi:SB 373.title: Housing: landlord and tenants; limitations on fees charged to tenants; provide for. Amends sec. 3 of 1978 PA 454 (MCL 554.633).
mi:SB 373.summary: As introduced, bars a rental agreement from charging an extra fee on every allowed rent payment method, so an agreement allowing multiple methods must offer at least one without an added charge.

mi:SB 413.title: Health occupations: psychologists; requirements for practice by limited licensed psychologist; modify. Amends secs. 18221, 18223, 18233 & 18237 of 1978 PA 368 (MCL 333.18221 et seq.).
mi:SB 413.summary: As introduced, raises the supervised postgraduate experience required for a limited-license psychologist from one year to two years and 3,000-4,000 hours, lets limited licensees practice without supervision, and changes the Board of Psychology's membership.

mi:SB 433.title: State agencies (existing): health and human services; educational materials regarding health dangers for youth using high-potency THC and cannabis products; require the department to provide. Amends 1976 PA 451 (MCL 380.1 - 380.1852) by adding sec. 1509.
mi:SB 433.summary: As introduced, requires the Department of Health and Human Services to develop a notice on the dangers of high-potency THC cannabis and vaping and on prevention and treatment resources, which schools must give parents by October 1 each year from 2026-27.

mi:SB 478.title: Property: conveyance of state property; transfer of certain state-owned property in Livingston County; provide for. Creates land transfer act.
mi:SB 478.summary: As introduced, authorizes the State Administrative Board to transfer about 93 acres in Green Oak Township, Livingston County, from the Department of Corrections to the Department of Military and Veterans Affairs, which may use it for a National Guard readiness center.

mi:SB 729.title: State finance: authorities; outstanding obligations of the state building authority; provide exception to the limit of. Amends sec. 8 of 1964 PA 183 (MCL 830.418).
mi:SB 729.summary: As introduced, exempts $421.3 million of State Building Authority bonds issued in June 2025 from counting toward the Authority's $2.7 billion cap on outstanding debt.

mi:SB 791.title: Highways: memorial; portion of I-475; designate as the "St. John Street Community Memorial Highway". Amends 2001 PA 142 (MCL 250.1001 - 250.2092) by adding sec. 124.
mi:SB 791.summary: As introduced, designates the portion of I-475 in Genesee County from Hamilton Avenue north to a quarter mile past Stewart Avenue as the "St. John Street Community Memorial Highway."

mi:SB 947.title: Natural resources: inland lakes; dam safety regulations; provide for. Amends and adds (See bill).   TIE BAR WITH: HB 5485'26
mi:SB 947.summary: As introduced, brings dams licensed under the Federal Power Act under state environmental department jurisdiction, raises dam permit fees, increases inspection frequency, and requires a dam registration process.

mn:HF 1849.title: Term limits provided for governor and lieutenant governor, and constitutional amendment proposed.
mn:HF 1849.summary: Proposes a state constitutional amendment, for the 2026 ballot, limiting a person to being elected governor no more than twice and lieutenant governor no more than twice, counting terms from the 2026 election.

mn:HF 5084.title: Preborn child given recognized right to life, and constitutional amendment proposed.
mn:HF 5084.summary: As introduced, proposes a state constitutional amendment for the 2026 ballot stating that a preborn child has the right to life, while allowing medical treatment to save the life or preserve the health of the pregnant person.

mn:HF 5140.title: Ownership, possession, and sale of semiautomatic military-style assault weapons and large-capacity magazines regulated; provisions for possessing dangerous weapons in schools, negligently storing firearms, and reporting on law enforcement firearms discharge modified; ghost guns criminalized; other gun safety provisions modified; and money appropriated.
mn:HF 5140.summary: As introduced, regulates semiautomatic military-style assault weapons and large-capacity magazines, criminalizes ghost guns, re-enacts the binary trigger ban, changes firearm storage, school weapons and extreme risk protection order rules, and appropriates money.

mn:SF 2077.title: Omnibus Outdoor Heritage Fund, Legacy and Lands bill
mn:SF 2077.summary: Appropriates $191.1 million from the Outdoor Heritage Fund for fiscal year 2027, changes state land and DNR licensing provisions, appropriates $80,000 to the Agricultural Utilization Research Institute, and extends unemployment benefits for certain iron ore mining workers.

mn:SF 2373.title: Omnibus Labor policy bill
mn:SF 2373.summary: Exempts minor league baseball players from minimum wage and overtime rules, changes construction code and licensing provisions, extends unemployment insurance for certain iron ore workers, and funds the Agricultural Utilization Research Institute.

mn:SF 3720.title: 2026 recommendations adoption of the Workers' Compensation Advisory Council
mn:SF 3720.summary: Changes workers' compensation law, including what an insurer owes when leaving the reinsurance association, how an insolvent member's liabilities are handled, legal fee limits and permanent partial disability compensation.

mn:SF 4282.title: Various agency forecast adjustments
mn:SF 4282.summary: Adjusts fiscal year 2026 and 2027 education, human services and Metro Mobility appropriations to match the February 2026 forecast, and changes K-12 programs, including new aid for Tribal contract schools and extended restroom grants.

mn:SF 4401.title: Omnibus Cannabis bill
mn:SF 4401.summary: Makes changes to Minnesota's cannabis law, including creating a cannabis macrobusiness license, streamlining adult-use and medical cannabis rules, requiring endorsements for authorized activities, changing labeling rules, and letting hemp license holders also hold cannabis licenses.

mn:SF 4476.title: Omnibus Human Services supplemental appropriations
mn:SF 4476.summary: Makes human services supplemental budget changes, including Medicaid continuity of care, long-term care facility rules, background studies, behavioral health, electronic visit verification, and appropriations for the Department of Human Services and other agencies.

mn:SF 4612.title: Omnibus Health and Human Services supplemental appropriations
mn:SF 4612.summary: Makes health and children and families supplemental budget changes, including Department of Health, hospital stabilization, health licensing board, medical assistance fraud prevention and child care licensing provisions, plus forecast adjustments and agency appropriations.
